body.untyped.evidence: Messages are records in a table of this process; nothing is ever typed. test/test-messenger-conformance.ps1 posts and observes no typed body.

idempotent.post.evidence: A second post of one messageId returns the recorded stage and makes no second record, in test/test-messenger-conformance.ps1 and test/test-messenger-port.ps1.

receipt.receiver.evidence: An in-process store for tests: there is no receiving session, and seen is set by a test helper playing one. Declined so that Resolve-HordeNodeMessenger, which requires receipt.receiver, never picks it (test/test-messenger-port.ps1).

wake.evidence: There is no session to wake; the store counts no wake (test/test-messenger-port.ps1).
